name: white rice
tip: Dry uncooked rice only. Keep sealed in a cool, dry cupboard. Follow the package date; cooked rice needs different storage.

name: brown rice
tip: Dry uncooked rice only. Keep airtight and cool. Follow the package date; whole-grain rice does not keep as long as white rice.

name: dry pasta
tip: For dried pasta, not fresh or cooked pasta. Keep dry and sealed; follow the package date.

name: rolled oats
tip: Dry oats only. Keep airtight and away from moisture. Use the package date when available.

name: quinoa
tip: Dry uncooked quinoa only. Keep airtight in a cool cupboard; follow the package date.

name: bulgur
tip: Dry uncooked grain only. Keep sealed, cool and dry; follow the package date.

name: couscous
tip: Dry uncooked couscous only. Store airtight and follow the package date.

name: wheat berries
tip: Dry whole wheat grain only. Keep in a sealed container away from moisture; follow the package date.

name: white flour
tip: Keep sealed, cool and dry. Follow the package date. Raw flour should not be eaten without cooking.

name: whole wheat flour
tip: Keep airtight and cool; follow the package date. Whole-grain flour keeps for less time than white flour.

name: breakfast cereal
tip: Unopened planning estimate. Follow the package date and reseal well after opening.

name: bread
tip: Short quality-planning estimate. Follow the label and freeze surplus slices. Discard mouldy bread.

name: dry lentils
tip: Dry uncooked lentils only. Store airtight and dry. Cooked lentils need refrigeration.

name: dry chickpeas
tip: Dry uncooked chickpeas only. Keep airtight and dry. Not the same as canned or cooked chickpeas.

name: dry beans
tip: Dry uncooked beans only. Store sealed and dry; prepare and cook according to package instructions.

name: canned chickpeas
tip: Unopened shelf-stable can only. Follow the label. After opening, refrigerate leftovers and use within 3–4 days.

name: canned kidney beans
tip: Unopened shelf-stable can only. Follow the label. After opening, refrigerate leftovers and use within 3–4 days.

name: canned black beans
tip: Unopened shelf-stable can only. Follow the label. After opening, refrigerate leftovers and use within 3–4 days.

name: canned corn
tip: Unopened shelf-stable can only. Follow the label. After opening, refrigerate leftovers and use within 3–4 days.

name: canned tomatoes
tip: Unopened shelf-stable can only. Follow the label. Refrigerate after opening and follow the opened-product instructions.

name: canned tuna
tip: Unopened shelf-stable can only. Follow the label and refrigerate after opening.

name: canned soup
tip: Unopened shelf-stable can only. Follow the label. Refrigerate after opening and follow its storage instructions.

name: canned coconut milk
tip: Unopened shelf-stable can only. Follow the package date. Refrigerate after opening. Chilled coconut drinks are a different product.

name: jarred pasta sauce
tip: Unopened shelf-stable jar only. Follow the label. Refrigerate after opening and use within its stated time.

name: peanut butter
tip: Unopened planning estimate. Follow the label; some natural peanut butters require refrigeration after opening.

name: jam
tip: Unopened shelf-stable jar only. Follow the label, including refrigeration instructions after opening.

name: pickles
tip: Only for unopened shelf-stable pickles. Refrigerated pickles must stay refrigerated. Follow the label after opening.

name: olive oil
tip: Unopened quality-planning estimate. Keep tightly closed away from heat and light; follow the package date.

name: vegetable oil
tip: Unopened quality-planning estimate. Store away from heat and light; follow the package date.

name: raisins
tip: Unopened planning estimate. Keep sealed and dry; follow the package date.

name: almonds
tip: Short quality-planning estimate. Keep sealed and cool; follow the label. Refrigeration can help preserve quality.

name: spinach
tip: Quality-planning estimate. Follow bag instructions and printed dates. Keep refrigerated and avoid excess moisture.

name: lettuce
tip: Quality-planning estimate. Keep refrigerated in the crisper. Follow package instructions for bagged leaves.

name: kale
tip: Quality-planning estimate. Keep refrigerated and prevent excess moisture.

name: broccoli
tip: Quality-planning estimate. Keep refrigerated; wash before preparation.

name: carrots
tip: Quality-planning estimate. Remove leafy tops and keep refrigerated. Follow package dates for prepared carrots.

name: bell pepper
tip: Quality-planning estimate. Keep in the crisper and wash before preparation.

name: cucumber
tip: Quality-planning estimate. Keep refrigerated; cut cucumber needs different handling.

name: mushrooms
tip: Quality-planning estimate. Refrigerate in a paper bag or follow package instructions.

name: strawberries
tip: Quality-planning estimate. Refrigerate in a ventilated container; rinse before eating.

name: blueberries
tip: Quality-planning estimate. Refrigerate in a ventilated container; rinse before eating.

name: apples
tip: Quality-planning estimate. Store refrigerated in a ventilated bag, separate from sensitive vegetables.

name: bananas
tip: Ripeness-dependent planning estimate. Keep at room temperature. Freeze peeled surplus fruit.

name: avocado
tip: Assumes unripe whole fruit. Ripen at room temperature, then refrigerate. The estimate changes with ripeness.

name: tomatoes
tip: Assumes whole fruit still ripening. Move to the fridge when ripe. Cut tomatoes need refrigeration.

name: potatoes
tip: Quality-planning estimate. Store whole potatoes in a cool, dark, ventilated place, away from onions.

name: onions
tip: Whole dry onions only. Keep in a cool, dry, ventilated place. Cut onions need refrigeration.

name: garlic
tip: Whole unpeeled garlic only. Store in a cool, dry, ventilated place. Prepared garlic needs different handling.

name: milk
tip: Placeholder planning estimate. The printed date and opened-product instructions take priority. Keep refrigerated on a main shelf.

name: eggs
tip: Raw shell eggs only. Keep refrigerated in the carton and follow the printed date.

name: chicken breast
tip: Raw fresh chicken only. Cook or freeze promptly. Keep sealed on the bottom shelf and follow the use-by label.

name: ground beef
tip: Raw fresh ground beef only. Cook or freeze promptly. Keep sealed on the bottom shelf and follow the use-by label.

name: canned beans
tip: Assumes an unopened shelf-stable can. Follow the printed label. Refrigerate after opening and follow the opened-product instructions.

name: frozen peas
tip: A quality-planning reminder, not a safety deadline. Keep frozen and follow the package date and instructions. This estimate does not apply after thawing.
